property: Mail transfer separates from an implementation tradition in which computer mail had been a feature of FTP and becomes a dedicated protocol responsibility.

date_or_range.notes: RFC 772 retrospectively documents the original ARPA Network mail/FTP relationship.

sources.supports: explicit statement that original ARPA Network computer mail was implemented as an FTP feature and explains MTP/FTP similarities

negative_claims: This edge does not claim all early ARPANET email was implemented only through one FTP command sequence.
It does not establish source-code descent for every mail program.
Message-format history is separate from mail-transfer protocol history.
open_questions: Recover exact FTP mail commands and implementations by RFC/release.
Locate NCP-era mailer source and spool formats.
notes: A responsibility-specialization edge supported directly by RFC 772's historical explanation.
